findings.note: The declared runner still reads struct stat using hard-coded offsets (`24` for every non-macOS Unix), although the supplied stat-offset evidence proves aarch64 glibc stores `st_mode` at offset 16 and offset 24 is `st_uid`. The runner can therefore publish protected files with an incorrect mode on supported Linux architectures; the claimed GetUnixFileMode fix is absent from the declared implementation.
